title: Nova ACT Assistant
description: A pattern demonstrating how to use Amazon Bedrock's Nova ACT (Action) capabilities for controlled task execution and automation with safety guardrails

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Integrates with Amazon Bedrock's Nova ACT for controlled task execution and automation
Implements comprehensive safety guardrails and execution monitoring

Supports both local and Lambda deployment options
Features built-in task automation and safety control mechanisms
